Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) also rose 13% after revenue climbed 118%. Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) gained 10% after earnings of $3.65 beat estimates of $3.04. Eaton (NYSE: ETN), a large supplier of electrical infrastructure for data centers, raised its full-year EPS targets and is up 7%. Bleeker's takeaway: earnings are beating expectations and point to 2027 being bigger than Wall Street expects, so watch the picks and shovels plays as earnings season continues.
